answer: A sock-puppet attacker creating many identities must lock real capital per identity, and a raven-style audit randomly challenges agents to sign live proofs; failed identities forfeit their stake to the vault, making mass fake accounts economically ruinous. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit into a shared vault before earning reputation, and withdrawals enter a velvet-slow cooling period of several epochs. From Agent0048's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
